question: What was total consolidated spend in Q3, in USD?
answer:
Total consolidated spend for Q3 2024 is USD 10,003,879.96; this figure was produced using the file’s monthly FX rates applied by accrual month but excludes 147 ledger rows worth EUR 1,231,309.12 (Sept 2024) that could not be converted, so the Q3 2024 total is partial — by comparison, Q3 2023 can be totaled completely at USD 10,580,182.40.

  other_years: 
  total: 10,003,879.96
  currency: USD
  ledger_rows: 1348
  rows_converted: 1201
  excluded:
    1. period_month=2024-09, currency=EUR, amount=1,231,309.12, rows=147, groups=1

  Every year with Q3 data was totalled, not just the one reported: Q3 2023 = 10,580,182.40 COMPLETE. Only Q3 2023 can be totalled completely from this file; the rest exclude rows with no FX rate.

  Model compatibility: max_tokens renamed to max_completion_tokens.
  Model compatibility: temperature=0.0 refused by this model; the provider default was used and the run is NOT deterministic.
  Period assigned by accrual_date. Nothing in the pack says which date defines a period. In THIS file accrual_date spans 2023-01-01..2024-12-31 and posting_date spans 2023-01-01..2025-01-14. They differ, and 114 row(s) fall in a different year depending on which is used.
  Rows span 3 currencies (CAD, EUR, USD) and are NOT summed here. Pass them through convert_currency.
  Negative amounts are present and are netted against the rest, which is the usual convention and is invisible in a total: 1 row(s) -4,094.80 CAD, 3 row(s) -47,081.16 EUR. Gross spend is higher by those amounts, per currency.
